label: 52% Feature add (active development) · 48% Maintenance (stabilised)
doc: Greenfield: heavy upstream framing, specification and design. Novel, creative work — the least automatable stage.
Feature-heavy full SDLC, implementation and verification dominate. Baseline automatability.
Stabilised product: validation, deployment and run rise, new build falls. Repeatable work, more automatable.
Mostly run and support, minimal new change. Routine, highly automatable work.
Decommissioning, migration and archiving dominate. Mechanical work, well automatable.
